item: Check the aircraft has been looked at by a qualified person before it moves again.
Check who was in the area and that their details are recorded.
Check photos, the time and the exact place were recorded.
Check the equipment involved has been made safe.
Check the person has been seen by a first aider or medical staff.
Check the weight, the task and the equipment used were recorded.
Check whether similar tasks need a second look.
Check witnesses and the time were recorded.
Check the person has been seen by a first aider or medical staff.
Check the hazard (wet floor, strap, uneven ground) has been removed or marked.
Check photos of the spot were taken.
Check who was there and the time were recorded.
Check the spill has been stopped and contained.
Check the size of the spill and where it ran were recorded.
Check possible sources of ignition nearby were considered.
Check anyone who was exposed has been looked at.
Check what happened and who was close were recorded.
Check what stopped it becoming worse was recorded.
Check whether the layout or the routine needs a second look.
Check where and when the item was found were recorded.
Check whether any aircraft or vehicle passed the spot before it was found.
Check where the item may have come from.
Check the equipment has been taken out of use and tagged.
Check what failed and when were recorded.
Check whether anyone was close when it failed.
Check anyone near the blast area has been looked at.
Check the equipment and the area for damage.
Check how the all-clear steps were followed.
Check where people and equipment were at the time.
Check what happened, when and where were recorded.
Check anyone involved has been looked at.
Check whether anything needs to be made safe.
